requirement: Desktop first-run: Connect now on the AI-account step turns the step Done in place (browser and device sign-ins)

oracle.invariant: stepsDone: the AI step is done exactly when an account is connected. Connect now: the caught callback connects and the step turns Done without closing the screen; a device sign-in shows the code, polls, then answers the status. The connect panel shows idle (Connect now), pending (browser/device) and connected states; no connected account leaves the step not done.
oracle.productSourceGap: no product file is imported, read or run through a supported form in the command's test files (see tests/qa/layers/unit/lib/sources.mjs)

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: Connect now: the vendor page opens through the app
no connected account: the AI step is not done
the Done / Not done chip and the checklist follow each step
a device sign-in shows the code, polls until confirmed
